summary: The corpus supports the existing single sense ausschelten, schimpfen. German verfluchen and English rant and rave do not independently establish new meanings.
Finite Preterit suffixes may encode actor and target together. An overt l-NP is not automatically the target: the adjacent wife/son clauses in PrS73 demonstrate l-marked actors.
Infectum-wa includes repeated/habitual abuse and counterfactual consequences. Surface -wa does not by itself establish habitual meaning.
Preserve s/ṣ/z spellings, r-l assimilation and stacked suffixes. Saʕallela is assigned provisionally to II from context, without inventing stemI.
The existing Imperativ is already the Dilo and Falako7 token. The parsed label is Imperativ; no inherited raw-label formatting is rewritten and no duplicate example is added.

All accepted Jan uses remain II.1 ausschelten, schimpfen. Basic Preterit and Infectum cells already have five examples after round 1; new selections are for suffix morphology and explicit target coding.
elox, ele and l ruḥi are targets, while -li marks the speaker in Mṣaʕarli. This is useful beside the round-1 question about interpreting overt l-NPs as actors or targets.
The quoted burning-fathers formula in Jan 3.21/475 illustrates abuse content through another verb; it is not a ṣʕr light-verb collocation. No duplicate idiom is added.
The generic d mṣaʕratle ste clause in Jan 3.17/340 is hypothetical Infectum, not a different sense or Detransitive.
Verify the legacy prs213/13 reference against PrS73/102 when applying the role correction. Do not replace the old citation on an assumed numbering conversion.
Resolve64/57 mṣaʕarralle ne: Infectum-wa, Preterit-wa or another result construction? No new box is asserted and no example is added.
MAC Joseph40 Mṣaʕárwalle is provisionally Infectum-wa from the habitual sequence with omarwa; confirm the morphology before using it as a diagnostic example.
Check reduced Saʕallela in PrS26/4 and voiced kəmzaʕrile in JTM5.2/50 against recordings/edition; no normalization is made.
Confirm the singular Halime versus reported plural actor in PrS3/4–5; preserve both reports.
Resolve actor, suffix segmentation and box for isolated Mṣaʕəranne in Jan 1.17/863; keep printed form.
Confirm exact segmentation of mṣaʕərlelən and the relation of retained r forms to inherited mṣaʕaḷḷe. The round-1 role correction remains unchanged and is not repeated in this round’s JSON.
Insult targets include religion and a prophet, oneself and a remembered hour; these are participant extensions of the already documented abusive speech meaning.
